adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sharing is enabled it calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: ... })` without any `AbortSignal`/timeout handling. Since the function is awaited by multiple OAuth refresh paths (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom/etc.), a slow or hung sync endpoint can indefinitely delay those refresh operations until some external/runtime timeout occurs. This is a concrete resilience/performance issue introduced by the diff, though not necessarily a deterministic correctness bug.
